How It Works

How Professional Office Cleaning Works

Our office cleaning process follows a systematic, six-step protocol designed to maximize pathogen elimination and provide verifiable documentation of results. Every step is performed by trained, background-checked technicians.

1
Office and Workstation Cleaning

Desks, cubicle surfaces, and shared workstation areas are dusted and disinfected. Trash receptacles are emptied and relined. Personal office areas receive vacuuming and floor care. Computer peripherals and phone handsets in common areas are disinfected.

2
Restroom Deep Cleaning

Full restroom sanitization using hospital-grade disinfectants — toilets, urinals, sinks, mirrors, partitions, dispensers, and floors. Supply levels are verified and replenished. High-touch surfaces (handles, switches, locks) receive targeted disinfection.

3
Kitchen and Breakroom Maintenance

Countertops, sinks, appliance exteriors, tables, and chairs are cleaned and sanitized. Trash and recycling are emptied. Floors are swept and mopped. Refrigerators receive scheduled cleanouts to prevent odor and health issues.

4
Lobby and Reception Presentation

Entrance glass, lobby furniture, elevator vestibules, directory boards, and reception counters are cleaned and polished. These areas receive the highest presentation standards because they form every visitor's first impression.

5
Conference Room Ready-Service

Conference tables are wiped, chairs straightened, whiteboards cleaned, trash removed, and supplies restocked after hours so every room is meeting-ready by morning. Day porter service provides between-meeting turnovers during business hours.

6
Floor Care and Verification

Carpeted areas are vacuumed using HEPA-filtered equipment. Hard floors are dust-mopped and wet-mopped. All work is documented through JaniTrack with timestamped photos. Periodic ATP testing verifies high-touch surface cleanliness.

FAQ

Office Cleaning FAQ — Buffalo, NY

Common questions about office cleaning services in Buffalo.

What is professional office cleaning?+
Professional office cleaning is the recurring janitorial maintenance of commercial office environments. It encompasses daily operations including trash removal, restroom sanitization, floor care (vacuuming and mopping), high-touch surface disinfection, kitchen and breakroom cleaning, lobby presentation, and conference room ready-service. Professional office cleaning differs from residential cleaning in its scale, equipment, product specifications, and the need for consistent quality across large, multi-area environments.
Can you clean our office without disrupting business hours?+
Yes. We offer after-hours (evening), overnight, and weekend cleaning schedules that complete all work before your team arrives in the morning. For daytime needs, day porter services handle restroom monitoring, lobby maintenance, spill response, and conference room turnovers without disrupting your team's work. Scheduling is fully customizable to match your office's operating hours and occupancy patterns.
How do you ensure consistent quality across multiple floors?+
Every floor receives a customized cleaning checklist specifying tasks, frequencies, and quality standards. Our JaniTrack system provides timestamped photo verification of completed work across every area. Supervisors conduct periodic quality audits using ISSA appearance level scoring. If quality varies between floors, we identify the root cause (staffing, training, equipment) and correct it — the data tells us exactly where to focus.
Do you provide restroom and kitchen supplies?+
Yes. Supply management is included in our service — we monitor paper towel, toilet paper, soap, and hand sanitizer levels, restock during every service visit, and manage vendor relationships for consumable procurement. You never need to worry about empty dispensers or last-minute supply runs. Supply costs can be included in the contract or billed separately at your preference.
What does office cleaning include?+
Our standard office cleaning includes trash removal and recycling, restroom cleaning and sanitization, floor vacuuming and mopping, high-touch surface disinfection (handles, switches, shared equipment), kitchen and breakroom cleaning, lobby and reception maintenance, conference room ready-service, and supply replenishment. Specialty services like floor stripping, carpet extraction, and window cleaning are available on periodic schedules.
How much does office cleaning cost?+
Standard office cleaning ranges from $0.05-$0.15 per square foot per cleaning visit depending on square footage, cleaning frequency, restroom count, and scope. A typical 10,000 sq ft office cleaned 5 nights per week runs approximately $2,500-$5,000 per month. Multi-floor buildings and buildings with high restroom density or food service areas cost more per square foot. We provide exact pricing after a complimentary facility walkthrough.
What is the difference between office cleaning and janitorial service?+
The terms are often used interchangeably. 'Janitorial service' is the broader category encompassing all recurring commercial cleaning. 'Office cleaning' specifically refers to janitorial service for office environments. The distinction matters when comparing to specialized cleaning types like medical office cleaning (which adds OSHA compliance) or school cleaning (which adds CDC protocols and non-toxic product requirements). Standard office cleaning follows ISSA appearance level standards and OSHA general housekeeping requirements.
